    - Deceased date is changed to NULL if set to '0001-01-01' or is in the future
    - Birth date is changed to NULL if set to '0001-01-01' or is in the future
    - Student ID will be autogenerated, including PERSON_ID (PID) for reference now.
    - Address type is one of ('PM','CM','P1','P2','BB'), for both phone and address
*/

{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH source_data AS
(
    
/****************
Emergency Contact
****************/
select cast(PERSON_ID as  CHAR(9)) as "PID"
    ,CAST(GENERATED_ID as char(10)) as "Studentnumber"
, cast('' as CHAR(1)) as "StandardInd"
, cast('' as char(10)) as "AddressType"
, cast('' as CHAR(60)) as "Street"
, cast('' as CHAR(10)) as "HouseNo"
, cast('' as CHAR(10)) as "HouseNoA"
, cast('' AS CHAR(40))as "City"
, cast('' AS CHAR(3)) as "Country"
, cast('' AS CHAR(10)) as "PostalCode"
, cast(null AS DATE) as "ValidFrom"
, cast(null AS DATE) as "ValidTo"
, cast('' as CHAR(3)) as "Tel_country"
, cast('' AS CHAR(30)) as "Tel_no"
, cast('' as CHAR(1)) as "Tel_standard"
, cast('' as CHAR(1)) as "Tel_SMS"
, cast('' as CHAR(50)) as "Tel_remark"
, cast('' as CHAR(1)) as "Tel_no_use"
, cast(null AS DATE) as "Tel_ValidFrom"
, cast(null AS DATE) as "Tel_ValidTo"
, cast('' as CHAR(3)) as "Mob_country"
, cast('' as CHAR(30)) as "Mob_no"
, cast('' as CHAR(1)) as "Mob_standard"
, cast('' as CHAR(1)) as "Mob_SMS"
, cast('' as CHAR(50)) as "Mob_remark"
, cast('' as CHAR(1)) as "Mob_no_use"
, cast(null as DATE) as "Mob_validfrom"
, cast(null as DATE) as "Mob_validto"
, cast('' as CHAR(3)) as "Emergency_country"
, cast(ec.TELEPHONE_ID as CHAR(30)) as "Emergency_no"
, cast(trim(relcd.SHORT_DESC) ||': '||ec.CONTACT_NAME as CHAR(50)) as "Emergency_remark"
, VARCHAR_FORMAT(CAST(ec.RCD_SET_TS  AS char(10))   , 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS "Emergency_validfrom"

, cast('2999-12-31' as DATE) as "Emergency_validto"
, cast('' as CHAR(241)) as "Email"
, cast('' as CHAR(1)) as "Email_standard"
, cast('' as CHAR(50)) as "Email_remark"
, cast('' as CHAR(1)) as "Email_no_use"
, cast(null as DATE) as "Email_validfrom"
, cast(null as DATE) as "Email_validto"
-- , cast('' as char(3)) as "EmailType" -- Added, not yet in SLcM
, cast('' as CHAR(40)) as "Street2"
, cast('' as CHAR(40))as "Care_of"
, cast('' as CHAR(20)) as "Building"
, cast('' as CHAR(10)) as "Room"
, cast('' as CHAR(10)) as "Floor"
, cast('' as CHAR(40)) as "Street3"
, cast('' as CHAR(40)) as "Street4"
, cast('' as CHAR(40)) as "Street5"
, cast('' as CHAR(3)) as "Region"
, cast('' as CHAR(10)) as "PO_box"
, cast('' as CHAR(10)) as "PO_postalcode"
FROM {{ ref('src_prs_person_mc') }} person 
    INNER JOIN  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_mc') }}  pid 
        ON pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
        AND pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9
    INNER JOIN {{ ref('src_ect_emer_contact_mc') }} ec 
        ON ec.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
    INNER JOIN {{ ref('src_rcd_relation_cd_mc') }} relcd 
        ON ec.RELATIONSHIP_CODE = relcd.RELATIONSHIP_CODE
where PERSON_ID in (select PID from SLCM.PID_LIST)
)

model.tss.v_08_IDENTIFICATIONNUMBER_MC.raw_code:
/*
    Logic: 
    - Birth city is stored in multiple columns. We combined them into one value in the following order: Graduate Birth City, Undergraduate, International Student
    - Deceased date is changed to NULL if set to '0001-01-01' or is in the future
    - Birth date is changed to NULL if set to '0001-01-01' or is in the future
    - Student ID will be autogenerated, the field PERSON_ID (PID) is included for reference now.
    - Convert Gender ID "OT" to "DI"

*/

{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH source_data AS
(
    
select 
        CAST(pid.PERSON_ID AS char(10)) as "PID"
        ,CAST(pid.GENERATED_ID as char(10)) as "Studentnumber"
        ,CAST('SSN'  AS char(6)) AS "ID_Type"
        ,CAST(person.SSN AS char(60)) AS "ID_No"
        ,CAST('' AS char(40)) AS "Resp_Org"
        ,CAST(NULL AS date) AS "Entry_date"
        ,VARCHAR_FORMAT(CAST(pid.PRS_SET_TS AS char(10))   , 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS "ValidFrom"
        ,'12.31.2999' AS "ValidTo"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Country"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Region"

    FROM  {{ ref('src_prs_person_mc') }} person
        inner JOIN  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_mc') }} pid
            ON pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
            AND pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9 
    where pid.PERSON_ID in (select PID from slcm.PID_LIST)


union

select 
        CAST(pid.PERSON_ID AS char(10)) as "PID"
        ,CAST(pid.GENERATED_ID as char(10)) as "Studentnumber"
        ,CAST(case when id.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9 then 'PID' 
            when left(id.person_id,1) = '9'
            AND (SUBSTR(id.person_id, 4, 2) BETWEEN '70' AND '88'
            OR SUBSTR(id.person_id, 4, 2) BETWEEN '90' AND '99'
            OR SUBSTR(id.person_id, 4, 2) BETWEEN '64' AND '65')
            then 'ITIN'
        else '' end AS char(6)) AS "ID_Type"
        ,CAST(id.PERSON_ID AS char(60)) AS "ID_No"
        ,CAST('' AS char(40)) AS "Resp_Org"
        ,CAST(id.CHANGE_DATE AS date) AS "Entry_date"
        ,VARCHAR_FORMAT(CAST(id.CHANGE_DATE AS char(10))   , 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS "ValidFrom"
        ,'12.31.2999' AS "ValidTo"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Country"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Region"

    FROM  {{ ref('src_prs_person_mc') }} person
        inner JOIN  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_mc') }} pid
            ON pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
            AND pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9 
        inner JOIN  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_mc') }} id
            ON id.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
    where pid.PERSON_ID in (select PID from slcm.PID_LIST)
    and (id.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9 or (
             left(id.person_id,1) = '9'
            AND (SUBSTR(id.person_id, 4, 2) BETWEEN '70' AND '88'
            OR SUBSTR(id.person_id, 4, 2) BETWEEN '90' AND '99'
            OR SUBSTR(id.person_id, 4, 2) BETWEEN '64' AND '65')))

union


select
        CAST(pid.PERSON_ID AS char(10)) as "PID"
        ,CAST(pid.GENERATED_ID as char(10)) as "Studentnumber"
        ,CAST(CASE WHEN PRSN_DATACODE = 'TRIENR' THEN 'Tribal Enrollment Number'
            WHEN PRSN_DATACODE = 'MMACID' THEN 'AMCAS ID'
            WHEN PRSN_DATACODE = 'PHRMID' THEN  'PHARMCAS ID'
            END AS char(6)) AS "ID_Type"
        ,CAST(PRSN_DATA_VALUE AS char(60)) AS "ID_No"
        ,CAST('' AS char(40)) AS "Resp_Org"
        ,CAST(prsn_data.PDC_SET_TS AS date) AS "Entry_date"
        ,VARCHAR_FORMAT(CAST(CAST(PDC_SET_TS AS date) AS char(10))   , 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS "ValidFrom"
        ,'12.31.2999' AS "ValidTo"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Country"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Region"
    from {{ ref('src_pdv_prsn_data_va_mc') }} prsn_data
        inner JOIN  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_mc') }} pid
            ON FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID = pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID
            AND pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9 
    WHERE PRSN_DATACODE IN ('PHRMID', 'MMACID', 'TRIENR')
    and pid.PERSON_ID in (select PID from slcm.PID_LIST)

)



select *
from source_data

select

    ,case
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMBASK' then 'MBK'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMBASE' then 'MBS'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMCRCO' then 'MCC'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMCREW' then 'MCW'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMFENC' then 'MFC'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMGOLF' then 'MGF'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMSOCC' then 'MSC'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMSWIM' then 'MSW'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMTRAC' then 'MTK'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMTENN' then 'MTN'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMVOLL' then 'MVY'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AMWAPO' then 'MWP'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWBASK' then 'WBK'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWCRCO' then 'WCC'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWCREW' then 'WCW'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWFENC' then 'WFC'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWSOCC' then 'WSC'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWSOFT' then 'WSF'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWSWIM' then 'WSW'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWTRAC' then 'WTK'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWTENN' then 'WTN'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWVOLL' then 'WVY'
    when athl.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AWWAPO' then 'WWP'
    else 'unknown'
    end as "Sports Type"
    ,CAST('' as CHAR(1)) as "Scholarship Applicability" -- This field is intentonally left blank
    ,SUBSTR(athl.PRSN_DATA_VALUE,3,2) as "Start Year"
    ,left(athl.PRSN_DATA_VALUE,2) as "Start Session"
    ,CAST(NULL as DATE) as "Start Date2" -- This field is intentonally left blank
    ,SUBSTR(athl.PRSN_DATA_VALUE,8,2) as "End Year"
    ,SUBSTR(athl.PRSN_DATA_VALUE,6,2) as "End Session"
    ,CAST(NULL as DATE) as "End Date2" -- This field is intentonally left blank
    ,SUBSTR(athl.PRSN_DATA_VALUE,10,1) as "Inactive (Official Roster)"
    ,CAST('' as CHAR(2)) as "Reason" -- This field is intentonally left blank
    ,CAST('' as CHAR(1)) as "Competed" -- This field is intentonally left blank
from {{ ref('src_pdv_prsn_data_va_mc') }} athl
    inner join {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_mc') }} pid
        on athl.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID = pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID
        and pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9 
    left join {{ ref('src_pdv_prsn_data_va_mc') }} firstterm
        on athl.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID = firstterm.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID
        and firstterm.PRSN_DATACODE = 'AAIFTE'
where athl.PRSN_DATACODE like 'AM%'
    or athl.PRSN_DATACODE like 'AW%'
)

/*
    1 row per student per lvl2 ethnicity code, then mapped to various orders and translations
*/

{{ config(materialized='table') }}

WITH source_data AS
(


/* Back to recursive */
WITH  SplitValues (
    FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID,
    PRSN_DATACODE,
    PRSN_DATA_VALUE,
    StringLength,
    SpacePosition,
    ExtractedValue,
    RemainingValues
) AS (
    -- Anchor part: Extract the first value and the remaining string
    SELECT
        FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID,
        PRSN_DATACODE,
        PRSN_DATA_VALUE,
        LENGTH(PRSN_DATA_VALUE) AS StringLength,
        LOCATE(' ', PRSN_DATA_VALUE || ' ') AS SpacePosition,
        -- Extract the first value
        CASE
            WHEN LOCATE(' ', PRSN_DATA_VALUE || ' ') > 0 THEN
                TRIM(SUBSTR(PRSN_DATA_VALUE, 1, LOCATE(' ', PRSN_DATA_VALUE || ' ') - 1))
            ELSE
                TRIM(PRSN_DATA_VALUE) -- Take the full string if no space
        END AS ExtractedValue,
        -- Extract the remaining values
        CASE
            WHEN LOCATE(' ', PRSN_DATA_VALUE || ' ') > 0 THEN
                TRIM(SUBSTR(PRSN_DATA_VALUE, LOCATE(' ', PRSN_DATA_VALUE || ' ') + 1))
            ELSE
                '' -- No remaining value if no space
        END AS RemainingValues
    FROM ISIS.PDV_PRSN_DATA_VA
    WHERE
        PRSN_DATACODE IN ('IPHI1', 'IPHI2', 'IPHI3', 'IPHI4', 'IPHI5', 'IPHI6',
                          'IPHSW1', 'IPHSW2', 'IPHSW3', 'IPHSW4', 'IPHSW5', 'IPHSW6', 'IPHSW7')
        AND PRSN_DATA_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(PRSN_DATA_VALUE) <> '' -- Ensure valid data
--         AND FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID = '2265193' -- Validation criterion

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive part: Process the remaining string
    SELECT
        FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID,
        PRSN_DATACODE,
        PRSN_DATA_VALUE,
        LENGTH(RemainingValues) AS StringLength,
        LOCATE(' ', RemainingValues || ' ') AS SpacePosition,
        -- Extract the next value
        CASE
            WHEN LOCATE(' ', RemainingValues || ' ') > 0 THEN
                TRIM(SUBSTR(RemainingValues, 1, LOCATE(' ', RemainingValues || ' ') - 1))
            ELSE
                TRIM(RemainingValues) -- Take the full string if no space
        END AS ExtractedValue,
        -- Extract the next remaining values
        CASE
            WHEN LOCATE(' ', RemainingValues || ' ') > 0 THEN
                TRIM(SUBSTR(RemainingValues, LOCATE(' ', RemainingValues || ' ') + 1))
            ELSE
                '' -- No remaining value if no space
        END AS RemainingValues
    FROM SplitValues
    WHERE TRIM(RemainingValues) <> '' -- Continue recursion until no remaining values
)

/*
    Logic: 
    - Birth city is stored in multiple columns. We combined them into one value in the following order: Graduate Birth City, Undergraduate, International Student
    - Deceased date is changed to NULL if set to '0001-01-01' or is in the future
    - Birth date is changed to NULL if set to '0001-01-01' or is in the future
    - Student ID will be autogenerated, the field PERSON_ID (PID) is included for reference now.
    - Convert Gender ID "OT" to "DI"

*/

{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH source_data AS
(
    
select 
        CAST(pid.PERSON_ID AS char(10)) as "PID"
        ,CAST(pid.GENERATED_ID as char(10)) as "Studentnumber"
        ,CAST('ZSNOUD'  AS char(6)) AS "ID_Type"
        ,CAST(person.SSN AS char(60)) AS "ID_No"
        ,CAST('' AS char(40)) AS "Resp_Org"
        ,CAST(NULL AS date) AS "Entry_date"
        ,VARCHAR_FORMAT(CAST(pid.CHANGE_DATE AS char(10))   , 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS "ValidFrom"
        ,'31.12.2999' AS "ValidTo"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Country"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Region"

    FROM  {{ ref('src_prs_person_des') }} person
        inner JOIN  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_des') }} pid
            ON pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
            AND pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9 
    where pid.PERSON_ID in (select PID from slcm.PID_LIST)


union

select 
        CAST(pid.PERSON_ID AS char(10)) as "PID"
        ,CAST(pid.GENERATED_ID as char(10)) as "Studentnumber"
        ,'YSSN' AS "ID_Type"
        ,CAST(person.SSN AS char(60)) AS "ID_No"
        ,CAST('' AS char(40)) AS "Resp_Org"
        ,CAST(id.CHANGE_DATE AS date) AS "Entry_date"
        ,VARCHAR_FORMAT(CAST(id.CHANGE_DATE AS char(10))   , 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS "ValidFrom"
        ,'31.12.2999' AS "ValidTo"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Country"
        ,CAST('' AS char(3)) AS "Region"

    FROM  {{ ref('src_prs_person_des') }} person
        inner JOIN  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_des') }} pid
            ON pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
            AND pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9 
        inner JOIN  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_des') }} id
            ON id.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
    where trim(SSN) <> ''
        and pid.PERSON_ID in (select PID from slcm.PID_LIST)





)

from source_data

model.tss.v_01_ZPIQCONVSTUDENT_MC.raw_code:
/*
    Logic: 
    - Birth city is stored in multiple columns. We combined them into one value in the following order: Graduate Birth City, Undergraduate, International Student
    - Deceased date is changed to NULL if set to '0001-01-01' or is in the future
    - Birth date is changed to NULL if set to '0001-01-01' or is in the future
    - Student ID will be autogenerated, the field PERSON_ID (PID) is included for reference now.
    - Convert Gender ID "OT" to "DI"

*/

{{ config(materialized='view') }}

WITH source_data AS
(
    
select 
        CAST(pid.PERSON_ID AS char(10)) as "PID"
        ,CAST(GENERATED_ID as char(10)) as "Studentnumber"
        ,CAST(BIRTH_DATE AS date) AS "Birthdate"
        ,CAST('' AS char(1)) AS "Gender"
        ,CAST('EN' as char(2)) as "Language"
        ,CAST(CASE WHEN person.DECEASED_DATE = '0001-01-01' or person.DECEASED_DATE > CURRENT DATE THEN NULL ELSE person.DECEASED_DATE end AS date )  AS "DeathDate"
        ,CAST(NULL AS date) AS "DeathRecdate" -- intentionally left blank

        ,CAST('' as CHAR(1)) as "VeriStat" -- intentionally left blank
        ,CAST(NULL as date) as "VeriDate" -- intentionally left blank
        ,CAST('' as CHAR(35)) as "VeriName" -- intentionally left blank
        ,CAST('' as CHAR(12)) as "BDUnknown" -- intentionally left blank
            ,CAST('LG' as CHAR(2)) as "Subtype"
    ,cast(name.LEGAL_FIRST_NAME as CHAR(40)) as "FirstName"
    ,cast(name.LEGAL_LAST_NAME as char(40)) as "LastName"
    ,cast(name.LEGAL_MIDDLE_NAME as CHAR(40)) as "MiddleName"

    ,cast(
        case when name.LEGAL_SUFFIX in ('JR','JR.', 'Jr.') then 'Jr'
        when name.LEGAL_SUFFIX in ('SR','SR.') then 'Sr' 
        when name.LEGAL_SUFFIX not in ('Jr','Sr','II','III','IV','') then ''
        else name.LEGAL_SUFFIX end as CHAR(15)) as "Suffix"

    ,CAST('LV' as CHAR(2)) as "Subtype2"
    ,cast(name.LIVED_FIRST_NAME as CHAR(40)) as "FirstName2"
    ,cast(name.LIVED_LAST_NAME as char(40)) as "LastName2"
    ,cast(name.LIVED_MIDDLE_NAME as CHAR(40)) as "MiddleName2"
    ,cast(name.LIVED_SUFFIX as CHAR(15)) as "Suffix2"

    ,cast(case when prsndata.USE_LIVED_ON_DIPLOMA = 1 then 'X' else '' end as char(1)) as "Use for Diploma"
    ,cast(case when prsndata.USE_LIVED_ON_TRANSCRIPT = 1 then 'X' else '' end as char(1)) as "Use for Transcript"
    ,cast('' as char(1)) as "Name Not Present"
    ,cast(case when prsndata.USE_LIVED_ON_DEANS_LETTER = 1 then 'X' else '' end as char(1)) as "Use for Deans Congratulatory Letter"

    ,cast(case when prsndata.GENDID = 'OT' then 'DI' 
        when prsndata.GENDID not in ('DI', 'DS', 'F', 'GN', 'M', 'TF', 'TM', '') then ''
        else prsndata.GENDID end as char(2)) as "Gender Identity"
    ,cast(addlinfo.GENDID_OTHER as char(50)) as "Other Gender Identity"
    ,cast(case when prsndata.SEXORT not in ('HS','BI','GL','DS','OT','') then '' else prsndata.SEXORT end as char(2)) as "Sexual Orientation"
    ,cast(addlinfo.SEXORT_OTHER as char(50)) as "Other Sexual Orientation"
    ,cast(prsndata.GENDEX as char(2)) as "Gender Expression ID"
    ,cast(addlinfo.GENDEX_OTHER as char(50)) as "Other Gender Expression"

    ,cast('' as char(9)) as "Pronoun" --TODO: Permission Issue
    ,cast('' as char(50)) as "Other Pronoun" --TODO: Permission Issue
    -- ,cast(pronoun.PERSONAL_PRONOUN as char(9)) as "Pronoun" --TODO: Permission Issue
    -- ,cast(pronoun.PERSONAL_PRONOUN_OTHER as char(50)) as "Other Pronoun" --TODO: Permission Issue
    ,case 
        when cast(prsndata.SEXBIR as char(2))  = 'Female' then 'F'
        when cast(prsndata.SEXBIR as char(2))  = 'Male' then 'M'
        when cast(prsndata.SEXBIR as char(2))  = 'D' then ''
        when cast(prsndata.SEXBIR as char(2))  = 'DS' then ''
        when cast(prsndata.SEXBIR as char(2))  = 'm' then 'Male'
    else cast(prsndata.SEXBIR as char(2)) 
    end as "Sex at Birth"


    FROM  {{ ref('src_prs_person_mc') }} person
        LEFT JOIN  {{ ref('src_pid_person_id_mc') }} pid
            ON pid.FK_PCH_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
            -- Represents the most-recent PID
            AND pid.CHANGE_DATE_CNTL = 9 
        LEFT JOIN  {{ ref('src_lps_lived_person_mc') }} name
            ON name.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
        LEFT JOIN  {{ ref('int_pdv_prsn_data_va_pivoted_mc') }} prsndata
            ON prsndata.FK_PRS_INTRL_REFID = person.INTRL_REF_ID
        LEFT JOIN  {{ ref('src_pda_prsn_data_addlinfo_mc') }} addlinfo
            ON addlinfo.FK_PRS_INTRL_REF = person.INTRL_REF_ID
        -- LEFT JOIN {{ ref('src_sl_personal_pronoun_mc')}} pronoun
        --     on pronoun.PID = pid.PERSON_ID

)



select *
from source_data

macro.dbt_ibmdb2.ibmdb2__get_catalog.name: ibmdb2__get_catalog
macro.dbt_ibmdb2.ibmdb2__get_catalog.macro_sql:
{% macro ibmdb2__get_catalog(information_schema, schemas) -%}

  {%- call statement('catalog', fetch_result=True) -%}

    WITH columns AS (
      SELECT
        COLNAME,
        TYPENAME,
        CURRENT_SERVER AS DATABASE, -- Should be replaced by DB from profile
        TABNAME,
        TABSCHEMA,
        COLNO
      FROM SYSCAT.COLUMNS
    ),
    tables AS (
      SELECT
        CURRENT_SERVER AS DATABASE, -- Should be replaced by DB  from profile
        TABSCHEMA,
        TABNAME,
        OWNER,
        CASE
          WHEN TYPE = 'T' THEN 'TABLE' -- Upcase here to work with tests
          WHEN TYPE = 'V' THEN 'VIEW'  -- Upcase here to work with tests
        END AS TYPE
      FROM SYSCAT.TABLES
      WHERE TYPE IN('T', 'V')
    )
    SELECT
      TRIM(tables.DATABASE) AS "table_database",
      TRIM(tables.TABSCHEMA) AS "table_schema",
      TRIM(tables.TABNAME) AS "table_name",
      tables.TYPE AS "table_type",
      NULL AS "table_comment",
      TRIM(columns.COLNAME) AS "column_name",
      columns.COLNO AS "column_index",
      columns.TYPENAME AS "column_type",
      NULL AS "column_comment",
      tables.OWNER AS "table_owner"
    FROM tables
    INNER JOIN columns ON
      columns.DATABASE = tables.DATABASE AND
      columns.TABSCHEMA = tables.TABSCHEMA AND
      columns.TABNAME = tables.TABNAME
    WHERE (
        {%- for schema in schemas -%}
          tables.TABSCHEMA = UPPER('{{ schema }}') {%- if not loop.last %} OR {% endif -%}
        {%- endfor -%}
    )
    ORDER BY
      tables.TABSCHEMA,
      tables.TABNAME,
      columns.COLNO

  {%- endcall -%}
  {{ return(load_result('catalog').table) }}
{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt.default__snapshot_merge_sql.macro_sql:
{% macro default__snapshot_merge_sql(target, source, insert_cols) -%}
    {%- set insert_cols_csv = insert_cols | join(', ') -%}

    merge into {{ target }} as DBT_INTERNAL_DEST
    using {{ source }} as DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE
    on DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_scd_id = DBT_INTERNAL_DEST.dbt_scd_id

    when matched
     and DBT_INTERNAL_DEST.dbt_valid_to is null
     and DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_change_type in ('update', 'delete')
        then update
        set dbt_valid_to = DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_valid_to

    when not matched
     and DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_change_type = 'insert'
        then insert ({{ insert_cols_csv }})
        values ({{ insert_cols_csv }})

{% endmacro %}

{% macro default__snapshot_staging_table(strategy, source_sql, target_relation) -%}

    with snapshot_query as (

        {{ source_sql }}

    ),

    snapshotted_data as (

        select *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key

        from {{ target_relation }}
        where dbt_valid_to is null

    ),

    insertions_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_valid_from,
            nullif({{ strategy.updated_at }}, {{ strategy.updated_at }}) as dbt_valid_to,
            {{ strategy.scd_id }} as dbt_scd_id

        from snapshot_query
    ),

    updates_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_valid_from,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_valid_to

        from snapshot_query
    ),

    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes %}

    deletes_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key
        from snapshot_query
    ),
    {% endif %}

    insertions as (

        select
            'insert' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*

        from insertions_source_data as source_data
        left outer join snapshotted_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key is null
           or (
                snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key is not null
            and (
                {{ strategy.row_changed }}
            )
        )

    ),

    updates as (

        select
            'update' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*,
            snapshotted_data.dbt_scd_id

        from updates_source_data as source_data
        join snapshotted_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where (
            {{ strategy.row_changed }}
        )
    )

    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes -%}
    ,

    deletes as (

        select
            'delete' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_valid_from,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_valid_to,
            snapshotted_data.dbt_scd_id

        from snapshotted_data
        left join deletes_source_data as source_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where source_data.dbt_unique_key is null
    )
    {%- endif %}

    select * from insertions
    union all
    select * from updates
    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes %}
    union all
    select * from deletes
    {%- endif %}

{%- endmacro %}

doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
